intro.title: Build shared worker tab sync demo
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple demo that synchronizes a counter across multiple browser tabs using a Shared Worker. You will learn how Shared Workers enable communication between different tabs or windows of the same origin. The main technologies involved are JavaScript, the Shared Worker API, and basic DOM manipulation. By the end, you'll have a working app where updating the counter in one tab instantly reflects the change in all other open tabs.
intro.usecase: Shared workers enable real-time synchronization across multiple browser tabs, a pattern essential for collaborative applications. You'll see this in multi-tab dashboards like Google Analytics or financial trading platforms where data updates must appear simultaneously across all open views. This technique also powers synchronized form experiences like shared document editors or multi-user configuration panels where changes in one tab immediately reflect in others. As a developer, implementing tab synchronization improves user experience by maintaining consistent application state regardless of how many windows users have open.
